questions.source_content:
GAZETTE NOTIFICATION
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Kota
Date: 24 November 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/231)
Subject: Compliance of Annual Statutory Audit Paragraphs and Budget Utilization Certificates (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Kota division are hereby informed that under 'Compliance of Annual Statutory Audit Paragraphs and Budget Utilization Certificates', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 9 November in the central monthly wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #331) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Kota, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and monthly movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Kota), 2. Budget Reconciliation #141, 3. Digital Indexing.
Additional District Collector
Neeraj Kumar Verma
solution_steps: 1. Select the Key Action Points line.
